meta.title: Code review (OpenCodeReview)
meta.description: Brings Alibaba OpenCodeReview (ocr) into DSH: the model-callable ocr_review / ocr_status tools, the /ocr-review command, and on-demand review (a "Start code review" button at the end of every completed turn plus a runtime skill the model can call; nothing is reviewed automatically by default). By default the LLM goes through a plugin-local bridge into DSH, so model, credentials and quota all stay with DSH. Optionally the review itself runs in a separate read-only subagent that hands structured findings back to the coding agent to fix.
